forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your e-mail address. If an account exists, you will receive a reset link.
forgot.done: If an account exists for this address, a link is on its way.

link.title: Sign in without a password
link.intro: Enter your e-mail address. If an account exists, a sign-in link is on its way.
link.done: Check your inbox. The link works once and is valid for 15 minutes.

signIn.title: Signing you in
signIn.working: One moment, your link is being checked.
signIn.invalid: This link is invalid, spent or expired. Ask for a new one.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.intro: Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new invitation.
invite.introNoPassword: Tell us your name to activate your account. You sign in with a link we e-mail you, so there is no password to remember.
invite.passwordOptionalHint: At least 10 characters. Leave both fields empty to sign in with a link instead.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Tell us where to reach you. Everything else you can add later.
register.done: Almost there. Open the e-mail we sent you to finish your account.
register.closed: This portal does not take sign-ups at the moment.
register.toLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: Enter the code from your authenticator app. A recovery code works here as well.
twoFactor.recoveryHint: No access to the app? Use one of your recovery codes.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: Welcome. Two steps and the portal is ready.

connection.title: 1. Connection to the service
connection.hint: Check the API key in the server configuration and try again.

admin.title: 2. Administrator account
admin.intro: This account manages users, branding and outgoing mail.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: Your current password is required to confirm the change.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: A second factor protects your account even when your password becomes known.
twoFactor.statusOn: Active. Every sign-in asks for a code as well.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.manual: Or type this key by hand:
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one replaces the code from the app once. They are shown now and never again.
twoFactor.disableIntro: Your current password is required to confirm this.
